text:
Type: white dandelion globe pendant lamp
Use: ambient decorative light over a dining table, sitting area or bed; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, bohemian
Materials: white paper flower-shaped petals on a wire frame, white fabric cord, white ceiling cup
Colors: white, warm glow inside
Shape: large sphere covered in many radiating star-shaped petals like a dandelion seed head, casts patterned shadows, hangs on a cord, large but light and airy
Feel: whimsical, airy, soft, dreamy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pastel textiles, green plants; Scandinavian, bohemian or contemporary rooms

product.name: MASKROS
product.description: Gives decorative patterns on the ceiling and on the wall.
